In reverse dyesub, the entire keycap except the legend is dyed, leaving the legend as the same color as the keycap base.

Pad printing has been the most popular form of keycap printing since the 1990s, which uses pads dipped into ink to transfer lettering onto the keycaps. Pad printed legends are known for a lack of durability.

Laser marking is the use of a laser beam to mark the legends onto the keycaps. Laser marking works well with straight lines, but has difficulty achieving clean coverage of solid fill areas such as arrowheads.
